proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D
  have e1 : dist A C ^ 2 = ‖C -ᵥ A‖ ^ 2 := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
  have e2 : dist A D ^ 2 = ‖D -ᵥ A‖ ^ 2 := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
  have e3 : dist B C ^ 2 = ‖(C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
  have e4 : dist B D ^ 2 = ‖(D -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
  have e5 : D -ᵥ C = (D -ᵥ A) - (C -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D C A).symm
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, inner_sub_right, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_comm (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A), real_inner_comm (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ A)]
  rw [real_inner_comm (C -ᵥ A) (B -ᵥ A), real_inner_comm (D -ᵥ A) (B -ᵥ A)]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ C) = 0 ↔ dist A C ^ 2 + dist B D ^ 2 = dist A D ^ 2 + dist B C ^ 2
